distribution_dates.notes: Version 1.0 was published earlier on the Health Data Nexus platform rather than on PhysioNet.

updates.frequency: Semi-annual, that is twice a year.
updates.update_details: Further versions of the dataset are released as new versions rather than in-place edits, each with its own DOI. Users are notified through news items on the hosting platform and through standard communication channels. Successive releases have added participants, added derived features, reorganized the file layout and corrected errors; the dataset itself is released as static versions rather than being dynamically updated.
updates.source_caveats: The semi-annual cadence and notification arrangements are stated in the project documentation against hosting on the Health Data Nexus platform; the current release is hosted on PhysioNet.

versions_available: 1.0 - first release of the Bridge2AI voice as a biomarker of health dataset, published on Health Data Nexus, providing 12,523 recordings for 306 participants.
2.0.0, 16 April 2025 - added 136 new participants; spectrograms reprocessed; free-speech spectrograms and MFCCs removed.
2.0.1, 18 August 2025 - corrections to the authorship list.
3.0.0, 16 December 2025 - added 391 new participants; the single phenotype file separated into individual files; articulatory and phonetic posteriorgram features added; files reorganized.
3.1.0, 1 May 2026 - no new participants, but additional data released for certain participants; broken Parquet files fixed; audio quality metrics and per-recording metadata added.
version_access.version_details: Each version has a unique DOI, and a concept DOI resolves to the latest version. Older versions remain listed on PhysioNet, but the files for version 1.1 are no longer available. The project documentation states that by default older versions continue to be supported, hosted and made available to researchers, and that the dataset publishers reserve the right to remove access to older versions.
